reason: The candle archive is not in this repository. backtest.py reads data/candles/daily_adj.parquet, which lives on Google Drive; the Drive secrets are not set on this repo, so a clean checkout has no input to backtest. Publishing an empty result would look like a failed strategy rather than a missing file.
note: No backtest is published because its input is absent, not because the strategies failed.

cautions.no_lookahead: A signal computed from a bar is executed at the NEXT bar's open, never at the close it was computed from.
cautions.costs: Commission and slippage are charged on every side. A strategy that only works at zero cost does not work.
cautions.not_forward: A backtest is a statement about the past under stated rules. It is not a forecast.
cautions.survivorship: The universe is today's listed stocks. Delisted companies are absent, which flatters every long-only result.
